_written: 2026-11-02, before tools/r01_figure/repeat3.py was run. Approved plan: user 'Yes, run it'. Step-1/2 tables and the per-SNV inventory (activity, C1, A11 calls_D, ClinVar class) had been viewed; no pooled result had.
cell: HepG2 run 3 only for statistics; HEK293T clone-level display only (no test).

G1_clinvar_plp_conflicting_in_site.rule: ClinVar Pathogenic, Likely pathogenic, P/LP or Conflicting SNV at 143-151

G2_site_breaking_other.rule: SNV at 143-151 with A11 SP1 PWM change d_pwm <= -2, not in G1 (VUS or unreported); kept regardless of activity

G5_clinvar_benign_lb.rule: ClinVar Benign or Likely benign SNV anywhere in the element

G6_clinvar_plp_outside_R3.rule: ClinVar P, LP or P/LP SNV outside 143-151

endpoints.site_occupancy: share of molecules (labeling >= 0.2) with a confident LLR call (P_chance < 1e-3) of length 10-40 bp whose midpoint lies in oligo 143-151; variant - WT, labeling-standardised, A9 random-effects se; A7 mask applied to variant and WT before calling (as fp_features)
endpoints.nucleosome_size: share of molecules with a confident call >= 81 bp whose midpoint lies in the element (A7 mask)
endpoints.e1_profile: per adenine, stored A10 E1 D (A7 mask), testable rows only
endpoints.element_wide_shift: stored A11 C1 (adenines > 50 bp from the SNV, +/-5 run)

pooling: DerSimonian-Laird random effects across SNVs within a group (one estimate per SNV): estimate, 95% CI, tau2, I2, k; per-adenine profile pooled the same way. Groups are compared descriptively (no between-group test).
hek293t: per clone (>= 20 molecules, labeling > 0.01), mean labeling-standardised inaccessible-fraction residual vs HEK WT at adenines 140-156 and at adenines > 50 bp from 147; edited A/T masked; WT clone distribution as reference; display only. Before use, check access.load_element('HEK293T') WT profile against explorer_v6 base.json.
pooling_inclusion: per-SNV estimates enter the pool when n >= 10 molecules and >= 3 clones (A9 thresholds without the >= 5 expected-events rule, which is what pooling is meant to overcome); written before the first run
